correctness.rationale: Monomially normalize any center of Hamming weight w to (1,...,1,0,...,0). For a nonzero vector v, let b be number nonzero coordinates off the center support and a0,...,a_{q-1} be multiplicities of field values in the w support coordinates. The minimum under multiplying v by c∈F_q* has exactly b+w−max(a1,...,a_{q-1}) mismatches. Multinomial arrangements on the support and binomial (q−1)^b off-support choices count all vectors; subtract the zero vector term z^w and divide by q−1 identical scalar representatives. This proves the generating polynomial and shells for any prime-power field, n≥1; it does not presume q prime. Monomial isometries act transitively at each weight. For q>2, shell at distance n has (q−1)^{n−w−1} elements for w<n, zero at w=n, strictly distinguishing weight; for q=2, deleting the zero vector from Hamming cube yields shells C(n,r)−1_{r=w}, also distinguishing w. Hence full isometry vertex orbits equal the weight classes. Independent direct q=3,n=3 projective enumeration recovered profiles w=1:[1,4,6,2], w=2:[1,5,6,1], w=3:[1,6,6,0].
